capabilities: Follows the repo’s declared skill read order before acting.
Mirrors are tracked for Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code agent pickers.
weaknesses: Effectiveness depends on MCP tokens, git remotes, and external services configured on the machine running the agent.
Very large skill files can crowd the model context window.
defaults.performance: This dashboard does not record runtime telemetry. Expect performance to track API latency, tool parallelism, and model choice.
learnings: When you add an agent, update `.cursor/agent-skill-bindings.md` and `.github/copilot/AGENT-SKILL-BINDINGS.md` together.
Close specialist sessions with `/agent-learning` when corrections should become durable skill edits.
suggestions: Keep Copilot agent files referencing `.cursor/skill-library/` paths (single source of truth).
Add measurable checks per agent in this file under `agents.<id>`.

capabilities: Loads the full skill registry for cross-domain orchestration.
Routes work to specialists when the user names `/jira-automation`, `/git-automation`, etc.
weaknesses: Large combined context; easy to exceed limits if every skill is pulled eagerly.
Broad scope increases the chance of answering without loading the right specialist skill first.
KrishnaAiGen.performance: Best when delegating early; avoid pasting entire product repos into one turn.
learnings: Prefer specialist agents for single-domain execution to reduce errors and cost.
suggestions: Split rarely-used guidance into separate skills and reference them only from relevant agents.

capabilities: UD Jira workflows: create Story/Bug/Task, subtasks, OE from SP, Done/RFT, QA comments, sprint helpers.
weaknesses: Rule density in `jira-workflow.md` requires careful section navigation (§ references).
MCP/Jira availability and permissions must be correct or actions fail mid-flow.
jira-automation.performance: Dominated by Jira REST latency and number of follow-up queries for verification steps.
learnings: Kanban-first defaults (board 894) mean sprint fields are intentionally omitted unless asked.
suggestions: Consider a quick-reference card at the top of the Jira skill for the most common happy paths.

capabilities: Commit/push/merge guidance with a master-first default for this repo.
weaknesses: Cannot see private remotes or credentials; user must authenticate locally.
git-automation.performance: Usually fast; merges may require human conflict resolution.
learnings: The develop sync flow is opt-in and should not run unless explicitly requested.
suggestions: Add a short checklist output after each push (branch, remote, divergence summary).

capabilities: Authenticated git operations against the Bitbucket `unify-enterprise` mirror when tokens are set.
weaknesses: Token type confusion (Bitbucket HTTP access token vs Atlassian API token) is a common failure mode.
bitbucket-automation.performance: Network-bound; large fetches can be slow on constrained links.
learnings: URL-encode tokens with special characters when embedding in remote URLs.
suggestions: Document a single blessed remote URL pattern per environment (slug vs x-token-auth).

capabilities: SQL Server restore and related database workflows from `db-restore.md`.
weaknesses: Requires local/remote SQL access; not applicable if only documentation work is requested.
db-automation.performance: Restore time depends on backup size and disk throughput.
suggestions: Add additional `db-*.md` skills and extend the agent read list when new DB playbooks appear.

capabilities: Slack MCP workflows: channels, messages, and workspace-aware operations when tokens are configured.
weaknesses: Slack API rate limits and workspace policy can block automation.
slack-automation.performance: Generally low latency for small reads; batch carefully for history scans.
suggestions: Keep prompts explicit about channel IDs vs names to reduce ambiguity.

capabilities: Customer customization flows: architecture reuse, gating, logging patterns.
weaknesses: Requires deep product context from Unify-Enterprise code not always present in AskAI alone.
dev-customization.performance: Depends on how much code context is loaded per request.
learnings: Two-step skill read (expertise then workflow) keeps prompts smaller until needed.
suggestions: Link to canonical code pointers (types/files) in the skill to reduce hallucinated APIs.

capabilities: Confluence page search, authoring, and knowledge-base maintenance via Atlassian tooling.
weaknesses: Large pages and permission boundaries can make automated edits risky without review.
confluence-automation.performance: Search and render can be slower on big spaces.
suggestions: Prefer draft-in-comment patterns for sensitive QA notes (see mirrored Jira §7 guidance).

capabilities: Persists corrections into skills/agents and keeps Cursor + Copilot + VS Code mirrors aligned.
weaknesses: Meta-edits can propagate mistakes if the learning payload is underspecified.
agent-learning.performance: Mostly file I/O and careful multi-file diffs.
learnings: Treat `/agent-learning` as the default close-out after specialist work when feedback should stick.
suggestions: Add a lightweight template for “what was wrong / what changed / where verified”.

capabilities: VS Code / GitHub autonomous variant with heavier tooling expectations (see its agent file).
weaknesses: Not the same as the KrishnaAiGen master; mixing them up causes mismatched assumptions.
KrishnaAIGen-autonomous.performance: Depends on enabled tools and workspace size.
learnings: Keep this agent’s scope clearly labeled in UI and docs to avoid accidental selection.
suggestions: Cross-link from the master agent doc to this variant with explicit when-to-use guidance.
